findings: Per-shell weight solving eliminates pinching completely — 0 collapsed, 0 inverted, 0 torn faces at every bend angle tested.
What it does not eliminate is collision: 160 shell pairs newly overlap at 15 degrees, 399 at 60. Rigid parts swing into each other.
The corpus's fragmentation scale (~0.18 on gasket's axis) bounds useful bone density. Below it, skinning degenerates to rigid part binding.
Two figures in the LUCA packets, given without sources, turned out real and citable — the material was carrying good science under bad packaging.
